translationRepairs: On gengchen day of the twelfth month Yelü Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
On gengchen day of the twelfth month Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
s0011 names 蕭圖古辭; 蕭 is Xiao, so “Yelü Tuguci” is a surname error and “Xiao Tuguci” restores the correct reading without other changes.
Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Yelü Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
The same 蕭圖古辭 appears in the literal focus unit; rendering the surname as Yelü contradicts 蕭, and “Xiao Tuguci” is the accurate fix.
On guimao day the court visited the Western Capital.
On guiwei day the court visited the Western Capital.
s0012 opens with 癸未; that stem–branch pair is guiwei, whereas guimao would be 癸卯, so the replacement is required.
On guimao day visited the Western Capital.
On guiwei day visited the Western Capital.
Literal English likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is the correct sexagenary reading of the Chinese day name.
On guimao day the court visited Shanyu Marsh.
On guiwei day the court visited Shanyu Marsh.
s0078 has 癸未, which is guiwei, not guimao (癸卯); the idiomatic day-name correction matches the Chinese.
On guimao day visited Shanyu Marsh.
On guiwei day visited Shanyu Marsh.
The literal line repeats the same 癸未 error as guimao; changing it to guiwei restores the attested sexagenary day.

On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; Yelü Tuguci, administrator of Huanglong Prefecture, and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan were immediately dispatched to congratulate.

On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; Xiao Tuguci, administrator of Huanglong Prefecture, and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan were immediately dispatched to congratulate.
s0113 dispatches 知黃龍府事蕭圖古辭; the surname is again 蕭, so “Yelü Tuguci” is wrong and “Xiao Tuguci” is accurate.
On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; immediately dispatched Huanglong Prefecture administrator Yelü Tuguci and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan to congratulate.
On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; immediately dispatched Huanglong Prefecture administrator Xiao Tuguci and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan to congratulate.
Literal English also writes Yelü for 蕭圖古辭 in the Huanglong Prefecture appointment clause; Xiao is the correct surname.
On guimao day an edict forbade the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.
On guiwei day an edict forbade the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.
s0157 begins 癸未; that day is guiwei, so replacing guimao corrects a sexagenary misreading without altering the edict’s content.
On guimao day, edict forbidden the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.
On guiwei day, edict forbidden the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.
The literal field has the same 癸未→guimao error; guiwei is the correct reading of the Chinese day graph.
On guimao day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.
On guiwei day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.
s0177 dates Gao Ba’s retirement to 癸未, which is guiwei rather than guimao; the proposed idiomatic fix is exact.
On guimao day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.
On guiwei day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.
Literal English likewise needs guiwei for 癸未 in the Gao Ba retirement notice; no other wording is at issue.

Twelfth month, on renzi day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Hudu was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Yelü Hudu who administered Northern Court privy affairs Xiao Weixin was made Southern Court chancellor and also Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

Twelfth month, on renzi day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Hudu was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Xiao Weixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Southern Court chancellor and also Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
Chinese has two parallel 以… clauses: 耶律胡睹知北院樞密使事, then 知北院樞密使事蕭惟信為南府宰相; the garbled literal fuses them, and the proposed split correctly separates Yelü Hudu from Xiao Weixin.

On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Li, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.

On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Mu, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.
s0190 lists 北院宣徽使劉霂; 霂 is Mu, so “Liu Li” is a wrong given-name reading and “Liu Mu” is correct.

On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Li, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.

On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Mu, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.
The literal field repeats “Liu Li” for 劉霂; Mu is the standard reading of 霂, matching the proposed repair.
